commit: fix: line breaks in multiline strings

truth.description: printString in src/common/util.js now returns a doc array instead of a string, and the CSS printer's selector-attribute branch in genericPrint still prints its value through adjustStrings, whose String.replace callback turns that array into comma-joined text, so an attribute selector whose quoted value continues onto a second line after a backslash prints ,[object Object], in place of the line break.

distractions.why: A TypeScript string literal type takes the fluid assignment layout rather than the break-after-operator layout that shouldBreakAfterOperator forces for a Flow StringLiteralTypeAnnotation, so the string stays after the equals sign and only its first line has to fit.
